title: Page 131
transc:
RR McCaine  Washn July 29 1864 
Viola Mackerel zebra Wolfs white that some of
rose Pacific & Negro have pocketed the Attica
at Conrads & Edwards Sampson probably to opr
rate on Watkins of Wesleys trains zodiac As
no panama has yet arrived here Shelby Wells
must look out for his trains Webster Jordan


12.30 P. M.
Sampson Breno  (no 1)  Wash. D. C. July 29. 1864.
Submit ---- It is wicked that Mose by
& White have pocketed the Attica at Ed -
monds & Con - rads Samson with penny publish
pacific & pebble vermin of negro ---- Send
out immedy your Panama pike a pagan &
some Squase to protect the Welch & also
any of Might's trains on Rock - ville &
